name: questail
description: Personal game archive — import, analyze, and own your game history

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @questail/core build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm --filter @questail/web exec tsc --noEmit -p ../../tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @questail/core pack --dry-run
scripts.start: pnpm --filter @questail/core build && pnpm --filter @questail/web build && pnpm --filter @questail/web build:ui && node apps/web/dist/src/server/run.js
